verdict.rationale: Productboard's Webhooks API can fire real-time events when feature status changes, and the REST API can associate feedback with customers, so a notification workflow could technically be built. However, there is no evidence of a native, PM-configurable 'notify customer on status change' feature — this would require custom engineering work using the webhook/API stack rather than an out-of-the-box automation. Missing for 10: a documented native closed-loop notification feature, evidence of no-code trigger setup for PMs, and any customer-facing email/notification templates tied to status changes.
